notes.title: Beer Factory update - Sandbox (beta branch)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I'm happy to bring you this update, which includes some new features, fixes and improvements.

This update took a bit longer than expected, mainly due to the work involved in migrating data structures from Blueprint (Unreal Engine's visual scripting system) to C++.

This transition removes the dependency on Blueprint-based structures, which are often unstable and can lead to unintended behavior.

Moving to C++ makes the project more robust, stable, and scalable for future updates.



 From now the updates are first released on the beta branch for a few days to evaluate stability and gather feedback.

 If no major issues are found, the update is then merged into the main build and becomes available to all players.



Sandbox

The new Sandbox Mode lets you enjoy the game with complete freedom, without any objectives or progression constraints. It’s designed for players who want to experiment, build, test, or simply have fun without limits.

In this mode, all content is available from the start, including late-game areas like the docks. You can develop your factory, try out different setups, or explore all game mechanics without needing to complete any progression milestones.

It’s the perfect way to experience Beer Factory at your own pace, stress-free and unrestricted.

Linux native support

Beer Factory is now available with a native Linux build, no more Proton required.

Welcome, Linux brewers!

How to have access to the update

[olist]
Go to your Steam Library
Right-click on Beer Factory
Select Properties
Go to the Betas tab
Choose the desired beta build from the dropdown menu
[/olist]

Note: For now, the "linux" and "linux_beta" branches are identical, as Linux support was only introduced starting from version 0.9.1.

More details here

Patch note: 
Changes & Improvements

 Added a new Sandbox Mode.
 Added native Linux support.
 Temporarily disabled the custom layer logo.
 Removed the redundant "Storage" upgrade in the computer UI.
 Employees now step aside when the forklift horn is used.
 Employees assigned to cleaning and logistics now prioritize unloading the truck over cleaning.
 Cleanable dirt now spawns with a slight offset to prevent blinking.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed physics collision sound effects.
 Fixed forklift driving animation.
 Fixed an issue allowing duplication of buildable objects.
 Fixed computer outline rendering.
 Fixed save system for placeable objects.
 Fixed persistent text after using the fusebox.
 Fixed persistent text after interacting with locks.
 Fixed computer’s camera view while the tuning tab is active.
 Fixed a batch of broken references (could cause crashes, memory leaks, or unexpected behavior).
 Fixed a batch of dangling references (could cause crashes, memory leaks, or unexpected behavior).
 Fixed forklift horn sound.
 Fixed employee pathfinding near the blue gates.
 Fixed employee animation after throwing a garbage bag.

notes.title: Release date
notes.notes:
Fantastic Beer Enthusiasts!

With great joy, we announce today the most anticipated moment in the history of virtual brewing. Our Beer Factory, an incredible simulation game where you have the chance to become a true brewing magnate, now has its release date!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385039/1a021c1002bf52776c48c75bbf5ddde20ea48598.png

Very soon, on January 10, 2024, we will open the gates of our virtual beer factory for your creativity and entrepreneurship. Get ready with your mugs because it will be an unforgettable journey through the land of aromatic hops, crunchy malt, and fermentation magic!

Beer Factory will transport you into the fascinating world of brewing challenges, where every decisive click brings you closer to becoming a true brewing magnate. You will design unique recipes, ensure the highest quality ingredients, manage production, all with the aim of winning the hearts of beer enthusiasts from around the world.

Prepare for countless opportunities to perfect your brewery, meet brewing experts, and participate in exclusive industry events. Beer Factory is not just a game; it's a journey through the land of brewing dreams!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1782570/Beer_Factory/

We invite you to our beery world on January 10, 2024, on the Steam platform. It will be a time when your beer passions receive digital wings. Explore the secrets of the art of brewing, experiment with recipes, and conquer the world with your one-of-a-kind brew!

We can't wait for you to join us on this fantastic beer empire adventure. See you on Steam, Beer Enthusiasts! Cheers! 🍻

notes.title: 🚀 BETA TESTERS NEEDED & IMPORTANT GAME UPDATE! 🎮
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385039/32cf2b61b81c22a4e8506866418e7d5580c88bda.png

Dear Brewers,

We've got some important news to share!

Firstly, the release of our eagerly awaited game will be postponed. We're committed to ensuring it's the best it can be and don't want to compromise on its quality. We appreciate your patience and understanding. As a token of our gratitude, we've decided to lower the game's price from its initial announcement.

Secondly, we're inviting you to join us in the final stretch! We're seeking 15-20 dedicated individuals worldwide to help shape the destiny of our game.

🌍 Why Become a Beta Tester?

Shape the Game: Your feedback will be invaluable in refining our game's experience. The release timeline hinges on your insights!
Rewards: Testers will receive a complimentary copy of our game upon release and access to some of our other titles.

Responsibilities:


 Engage with the game critically.
 Report bugs, glitches, and language discrepancies.
 Actively collaborate with our development team.


Interested? All applicants MUST fill out our application form.

Sign up here

Your unwavering support means the world to us. Together, let's make gaming history!

Warm regards,
Beer Factory Team
